data.name: Kunika
data.gender_notes: Kunika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kunika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ku' meaning prosperity and 'Nika' meaning goddess. Kunika is the goddess of prosperity and abundance. She is often depicted with a lotus in her hand, symbolizing her connection to nature and the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth. The name Kunika carries the meaning “Goddess of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kunika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of prosperity and abundance in Hinduism
data.etymology: Kunika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kunika total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
